llm_response.reason: The website amiriit.it displays multiple scam indicators: hidden WHOIS/company info, inaccessible About Us page, inconsistent and ambiguous privacy policy referencing a different domain (amiries.es), SSL security warnings, and potential spoofing of the legitimate Amiri brand. These strongly align with typical fake online shopping scams—namely lack of legitimate contact details, unclear business identity, ambiguous customer info practices, domain inconsistency, and brand impersonation. All evidence points toward scam activity.
